articles.title: Athanor: An Agent-Native System for Autonomous Post-Training Research
articles.summary: The paper introduces Athanor, an open agent-native system for autonomous post-training research in which frontier AI agents independently improve a raw base model using public data and real GPU infrastructure. In a 104-hour campaign, four Claude Opus 5.5 agents improved Qwen3-4B-Base to performance levels that matched or slightly exceeded the official instruct version on average across reported development and held-out suites.
articles.advisor_relevance: This is not a commercial deployment, but it is a concrete signal that frontier agents may increasingly automate parts of AI model development, including data construction, training algorithm changes, hyperparameter tuning, evaluation, and iterative research decisions.
